noAccess.body: ExampleLab has not been assigned to you yet. An admin of your organisation gives it to you in the Beyondles Suite under Administration, Products and access.

noAccess.titleNotConfigured: ExampleLab is not fully set up here yet
noAccess.bodyNotConfigured: This environment cannot ask the Beyondles platform who may use ExampleLab, so it stays closed for everyone. This is not about your account. The operator sets PLATFORM_API_URL and PLATFORM_API_KEY and restarts.
noAccess.bodyAllowed: This page is just a notice. Your account is enabled.
